premise.claim: RBG only supports all-or-nothing group-level gang scheduling; there is no way to express a per-role minimum (e.g. start once 2 of 4 prefill instances can be placed), which is what KEP-430 asks for.
premise.evidence: On base, pkg/scheduler/volcano/manager.go and pkg/scheduler/k8s-scheduler-plugin/manager.go both hardcode MinMember = rbg.GetGroupSize() with no subGroupPolicy and no per-role knob; the only switch is the boolean annotation workloads.x-k8s.io/group-gang-scheduling. KEP PR sgl-project/rbg#430 is merged, so the design is accepted upstream. See results/P0-base-no-per-role-minimum.txt
premise.notCovered: Role-level gang is reachable only on Volcano >= 1.14 (implemented entirely via spec.subGroupPolicy). On scheduler-plugins the same minReplicas config returns a hard error, so the KEP goal is half delivered. Acceptable as a first step, but it should be documented rather than surfaced as a runtime error.

round2Findings.claim: buildSubGroupPolicy always sets MatchLabelKeys=[rolebasedgroup.workloads.x-k8s.io/role-instance-name], but that label is only written on the RoleInstanceSet path. For roles backed by Deployment/StatefulSet the label is absent, so Volcano cannot partition the role into per-instance subGroups and the declared subGroupSize/minSubGroups describe a partition that does not exist.
round2Findings.observed: GREEN on PR head - the key is emitted for every workload type, including Deployment and StatefulSet.
round2Findings.severityNote: Downgraded major->minor: RBG no longer supports Deployment/StatefulSet roles, so the missing label only affects deprecated workload types fresh installs will not use.

round2Findings.claim: calculateGangMinimum only sums roles present in rbg.Spec.Roles. A minReplicas map keyed by a role name that does not exist (typo, renamed role) yields minMember=0 and an empty subGroupPolicy, silently turning gang scheduling off instead of failing validation.
round2Findings.observed: GREEN on PR head - minMember collapses to 0 with no error and no event.

round2Findings.claim: Same defect as F2 stated as the intended contract: when gang scheduling is requested, minMember must never be 0.
round2Findings.observed: RED on PR head - the contract is violated.

round2Findings.claim: InjectPodSchedulingFields ignores its role argument, so every role gets schedulerName=volcano plus the PodGroup annotation - including roles the gang strategy deliberately excluded from minReplicas. Those pods are counted by Volcano against a minMember that does not budget for them.
round2Findings.observed: GREEN on PR head - the excluded role is still joined to the PodGroup.

round2Findings.claim: The role parameter newly added to GangScheduler.InjectPodSchedulingFields is dead in both implementations - passing different roles (or nil) produces identical output.
round2Findings.observed: GREEN on PR head - the argument is unused.

round2Findings.claim: minReplicas is never checked against the role's own replicas. minReplicas[role] > *role.Replicas produces a minMember larger than the number of pods the RBG will ever create, so the gang can never be satisfied and all pods stay Pending forever.
round2Findings.observed: RED on PR head - no clamp, no rejection.

round2Findings.claim: Zero and negative minReplicas values are accepted. Zero emits a meaningless subGroupPolicy entry (minSubGroups=0); negative produces a negative contribution to minMember. No CRD-level minimum marker on the field either.
round2Findings.observed: RED on PR head - both values pass through unvalidated.

round2Findings.claim: GetGangStrategy discards CoordinatedPolicyRule.Roles. A rule scoped to a subset of roles is applied as if it were group-wide, so the API's own scoping field has no effect on gang scheduling.
round2Findings.observed: GREEN on PR head - the rule's Roles list is never read.

round2Findings.claim: GetGangStrategy returns on the FIRST policy rule carrying Scheduling.Gang. A CoordinatedPolicy declaring two gang rules - a natural way to express per-role minimums given that Roles exists on the rule - has all but the first silently dropped, with no error, event, or status condition.
round2Findings.observed: RED on PR head - only the first rule's MinReplicas survives.

round2Findings.claim: GetGangStrategy treats any error from the CoordinatedPolicy read as 'no policy' (err == nil guard). A transient API failure or an RBAC denial is indistinguishable from absence, so gang scheduling silently degrades to the annotation path or to off.
round2Findings.observed: RED on PR head - an injected Internal error is swallowed and nil is returned.

round2Findings.claim: Nothing watches CoordinatedPolicy. Editing or deleting the gang strategy does not trigger a reconcile of the owning RBG; the PodGroup keeps its stale minMember/subGroupPolicy until something else touches the RBG.
round2Findings.observed: Confirmed by code reading, not a harness test: no Watches/Owns for CoordinatedPolicy in the RBG controller's SetupWithManager, and test/e2e/testcase/v1alpha2/gang_scheduling.go carries the comment "controller doesn't watch CoordinatedPolicy" plus an rbg.Spec poke that exists only to force reconciliation. See results/F9-no-coordinatedpolicy-watch.txt

round2Findings.claim: Gang scheduling enabled through the new CoordinatedPolicy path never turns on the RoleInstance-level gang enforcement that the annotation path documents: the orphan-pod check and atomic all-pods-of-an-instance recreation gated by RoleInstanceGangSchedulingAnnotationKey. This matters more under subGroupPolicy, not less, because a Volcano subGroup IS exactly one RoleInstance - non-atomic instance recreation breaks the very subGroup minimum the PR introduces. Separately, the documented claim that this annotation 'is derived automatically from the RBG-level GangSchedulingAnnotationKey annotation during RoleInstanceSet reconciliation' is unfulfilled: no code writes it from the group annotation, the two write sites only propagate an already-present value.
round2Findings.observed: Confirmed by code reading. pkg/scheduler/common/gang_strategy.go is the only new consumer of gang config and builds a PodGroup only; nothing in the CoordinatedPolicy path sets the RoleInstance flag read at pkg/reconciler/roleinstance/sync/instance_scale.go:767. See results/F10-coordinatedpolicy-skips-roleinstance-gang.txt

round2Findings.claim: Harness-bites check: the happy path must be GREEN, otherwise the RED results above could be harness bugs rather than product defects.
round2Findings.observed: GREEN on PR head - the harness reads the real API correctly.

findings.claim: Round-2 F1 (MatchLabelKeys emitted for workload types that never write the role-instance-name label). FIXED: per-role gang is only offered on the RoleInstanceSet path; a non-RIS backing is rejected rather than silently emitting a partition that cannot exist.

Round-2 F2 (unknown role name in minReplicas silently yields minMember=0). FIXED: UnknownGangRoles surfaces the typo, the RBG sets GangConfigured=False with an IncompatibleGangConfig message, and no PodGroup is built.
Round-2 F2b (minMember must never collapse to 0 when gang is requested). FIXED: a gang strategy whose covered roles all resolve to 0 is rejected as incompatible.

Round-2 F3 (InjectPodSchedulingFields ignored its role argument, enrolling excluded roles into the PodGroup). FIXED: RoleInGang gates enrollment - an excluded role gets schedulerName=volcano but is not annotated into the gang PodGroup, so it is not counted against minMember.

Round-2 F4 (minReplicas > role.Replicas produced an unsatisfiable minMember, pods Pending forever). FIXED: the config is rejected as incompatible ('can never be satisfied') instead of building an impossible PodGroup.
Round-2 F5 (zero/negative minReplicas accepted). FIXED: rejected both at the CoordinatedPolicy admission webhook and in strategy resolution.

Round-2 F6 (CoordinatedPolicyRule.Roles scoping discarded). FIXED: a rule's minimums apply only to its scoped roles; out-of-scope minimums are rejected at admission and ignored in the merged strategy.
Round-2 F7 (only the first gang rule survived). FIXED: MergeGangStrategies unions roles across all gang rules, max-minimum wins per role.
Round-2 F8 (CoordinatedPolicy read error swallowed as 'no policy'). FIXED: the error propagates from ResolveGangStrategy instead of degrading silently.

Round-2 F9 (nothing watched CoordinatedPolicy; edits left a stale PodGroup). FIXED: the RBG controller adds Watches(CoordinatedPolicy) with GenerationChangedPredicate. Verified live via case r3-watch - editing prefill minimum 1->2 propagated PodGroup minMember 1->2 with the RBG untouched (resourceVersion unchanged).

Round-2 F10 (CoordinatedPolicy path never derived the RoleInstance-level gang annotation). FIXED: the RIS reconciler derives rbg.workloads.x-k8s.io/role-instance-gang-scheduling=true for gang-covered roles. Verified live - all covered RIS annotated true, out-of-scope sidecar left unannotated.
New-behavior contract: an all-or-nothing (whole-group) rule subsumes only its own roles and does not absorb the per-role minimums declared by other rules.
New-behavior contract: the resolve-once GangStrategy carried on ctx is keyed per-RBG and does not leak across different RBGs reconciled in the same context.
New-behavior contract: a CoordinatedPolicy with no gang section falls back to the legacy group-gang-scheduling annotation path unchanged.
New-behavior end-to-end contract: a merged multi-rule policy resolves to the correct PodGroup minMember and subGroupPolicy spec.
scheduler-plugins path: per-role minReplicas is rejected at admission (hard error) since subGroupPolicy is a Volcano-only capability. Documents the KEP goal being half-delivered off Volcano.
Harness-bites check: the happy paths must PASS, otherwise the contract results above could be harness bugs rather than real product behavior.
findings.observed: PASS on reviewedSha bd9ee4dd - the harness reads the real API correctly.

liveNoteRound2: L3 WAS run this round on a 3-node ACK cluster (k8s v1.36.1) with Volcano 1.14.4 and --scheduler-name=volcano. The original PR branch predates the restartPolicy structuring in the cluster's installed CRD, so the raw PR binary failed every typed LIST with a decode error (setup version-skew, not a gang finding). The branch was rebased onto upstream/main (ZERO conflicts - clean merge signal) and deployed with a test-only env-gated field selector metadata.namespace=v434-verify on the RBG/RoleInstanceSet/RoleInstance informers, so the controller reconciled only the test namespace and never touched the live nginx-cluster RBG. Observed PodGroups matched predictions exactly: baseline-ok minMember=2 (2 Running); f2-typo minMember=0 (F2); f3-excluded minMember=1 but excluded sidecar still schedulerName=volcano and joined group f3-excluded (F3); f4-exceeds minMember=5 with only 2 pods, Pending forever (F4); f5-zero minMember=0 accepted (F5); f6-scope minMember=2 - decode joined despite scope=[prefill] (F6); f7-tworules minMember=1 - second rule dropped (F7). F9 live: editing CoordinatedPolicy prefill 2->3 left PodGroup minMember=2 even after an RBG reconcile poke. Cluster restored afterward to controller v0.8.0-0c00546d, test namespace deleted, nginx-cluster confirmed READY 4/4 untouched.
